an6.42:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo, tadavasari.
an6.42:1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an6.42:1.5: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an6.42:1.6: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato”
an6.42:1.7: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno …pe… buddho bhagavā”ti.
an6.42:1.8: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ …pe… [sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ] arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
an6.42:1.9: atha kho icchānaṅgalikā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā.
an6.42:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
an6.42:2.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi:
an6.42:2.3: ke pana te nāgita uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilopeti.
an6.42:2.4: ete bhante icchānaṅgalikā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā bhagavantaṃyeva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghaṃ cāti.
an6.42:2.5: māhaṃ nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ. mā ca mayā yaso.
an6.42:2.6: yo kho nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an6.42:2.7: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyāti.
an6.42:3.3: yena yenevadāni bhante bhagavā gamissati, tanninnāva bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā, negamā ce va jānapadā ca.
an6.42:3.4: seyyathāpi bhante thullaphusitake deve vassante yathāninnaṃ udakāni pavattanti,
an6.42:3.5: eva meva kho bhante yena yenevadāni bhagavā gamissati, tanninnāva bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
an6.42:4.1: māhaṃ nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ. mā ca mayā saso.
an6.42:4.2: yo kho nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an6.42:4.3: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkāra silokasukhaṃ sādiyeyya.
an6.42:5.1: (1) idāhaṃ nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāriṃ samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an6.42:5.3: “idānimaṃ āyasmantaṃ ārāmiko vā samaṇuddeso vā sahadhammiko vā tamhā samādhimhā cāvessatī”ti
an6.42:5.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena. (2)
an6.42:6.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ araññe pacalāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an6.42:6.3: “idāni ayamāyasmā imaṃ niddākilamathaṃ paṭivinodetvā araññasaññaṃ yeva manasi karissati ekattanti.
an6.42:6.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena. (3)
an6.42:7.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi araññakaṃ araññe asamāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an6.42:7.3: “idāni ayamāyasmā asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādahissati samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī”ti.
an6.42:7.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena. (4)
an6.42:8.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ araññe samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an6.42:8.3: idāni ayamāyasmā avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimocessati, vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī”ti.
an6.42:8.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena. (5)
an6.42:9.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāriṃ lābhiṃ cīvara piṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
an6.42:9.2: so taṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ nikāmayamāno riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, riñcati araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni,
an6.42:9.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena. (6)
an6.42:10.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
an6.42:10.2: so taṃ lābhasakkāra silokaṃ paṭipaṇāmetvā na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, na riñcati araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni.
an6.42:10.3: tenāhaṃ nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
an6.42:11.1: yasmāhaṃ nāgita, samaye addhānamaggapaṭipanno na kañci passāmi purato vā pacchato vā, phāsu me nāgita, tasmiṃ samaye hoti antamaso uccārapassāvakammāyāti.
